" alt="Aprendizaje + Servicio">
      </div>
      <div>Portal Integrado de Gestión e Información A+S · Universidad Autónoma de Chile · 2026</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</footer>

<div class="visor" id="visor" role="dialog" aria-label="Vista ampliada"><button aria-label="Cerrar">×</button><img alt=""></div>

<script>
(function(){
  // aparición al hacer scroll
  var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('visible');io.unobserve(e.target);}})},{threshold:.12});
  document.querySelectorAll('.aparece').forEach(function(el){io.observe(el)});
  // índice lateral activo + barra de progreso
  var links=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.indice a'));
  var secs=links.map(function(a){return document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'))});
  var barra=document.getElementById('progreso');
  function alScroll(){
    var y=window.scrollY+window.innerHeight*.4, act=0;
    secs.forEach(function(s,i){if(s&&s.offsetTop<=y)act=i});
    links.forEach(function(a,i){a.classList.toggle('activo',i===act)});
    var h=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight;
    barra.style.width=(h>0?window.scrollY/h*100:0)+'%';
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll',alScroll,{passive:true});alScroll();
  // visor de imagen completa
  var visor=document.getElementById('visor'), vimg=visor.querySelector('img');
  document.querySelectorAll('.marco').forEach(function(m){
    m.addEventListener('click',function(){var im=m.querySelector('.vista img');vimg.src=im.src;vimg.alt=im.alt;visor.classList.add('abierto');visor.scrollTop=0;});
  });
  visor.addEventListener('click',function(){visor.classList.remove('abierto')});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')visor.classList.remove('abierto')});
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
